PROCESS BEFORE OUTPUT.																																
*																																
  MODULE STATUS_0100.																																
*																																
  LOOP AT GT_BSEG INTO ACGL_ITEM WITH CONTROL TC_100.																																
  ENDLOOP.																																
*																																
PROCESS AFTER INPUT.																																
  MODULE EXIT AT EXIT-COMMAND.																																
  LOOP.																																
																																
  ENDLOOP.																																
* MODULE USER_COMMAND_0100.
